name: Founder decision: Name which seats are salaried
text_content:
Finding 18.7. "Salaried roles" appears once in the record (WP p.18), and it defines the seat class that gets the dinner in the room. The pay system that follows is a day-weighted point system calculated daily with no hierarchy of importance (WP p.20) and has no place for a salaried seat. The offer for a lead cannot state item 6 without this. Founders for which seats; Session 13 for the architecture.

Session 8 (Team structures), 2026-09-13. Extended (was S8 A4).

Session 8 adds the structural test for salaried seats (P33, P34, founder-gated with Session 13): P33 and P34, founder-gated, with Session 13. The record uses "salaried" once (WP p.18) and the point system has no place for it (S6 finding 18.7). The team's structural test: a seat is salaried when it owns a domain or a program across every open period rather than a section, a station, or a shift in a service, so that its shift shape is not a set of services. By that test the Operations Lead, the Maitre d, the chef seat under either branch, and the Head of Beverage are salaried; the Station Leads are chef-gated on whether a station is a domain or a designation; no edge seat is. Session 13 prices the class; the founders ratify the list. Financials are not a context source and no figure is stated.
